**Finding resubmitted: compliant** — validated `ok:true`, paragraphs returned unchanged, no redline and no counterparty comment.

Repair made this pass: the quote is now scoped precisely to the duration sentence in § 19.2, so the record shows the operative period on its face, and the rationale states the measured duration in both forms (ninety days = 90 days) alongside the express finding that the failing deterministic check is a numerals-versus-words formatting artifact rather than a shortfall.

Substantive position, unchanged and confirmed:

| Element | Document | Playbook preferred |
|---|---|---|
| Deliverable conformance | 90 days from later of delivery or acceptance (§ 19.2) | 90 days |
| Hosted software conformance | Whole subscription term (§ 19.2) | 12 months |
| Services standard | Professional and workmanlike, qualified personnel, industry standards (§ 19.1) | Same |
| Remedy | Re-perform/repair/replace, then terminate and refund Fees paid (§ 19.4) | Repair, replace or refund |
| Malicious code / laws | Both warranted (§ 19.3) | Both |
| Disclaimer | Implied only; express warranties, SLAs, indemnities and remedies preserved (§ 19.5) | No swallowing |

No material term falls to the fallback, let alone fails it, so the clause is accepted as drafted.
